title: The Words Written Again
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who starts over when his tower is bumped down, and tonight Baruch picks up his pen and writes every burned word a second time, because something worth making is worth making again.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because starting over takes courage, and that is his kind of brave. In Beau’s world today: his tall block tower gets bumped over right before show-and-tell. His chin wobbles for a second. Then he kneels down and starts stacking again from the very bottom. Just like Baruch writing every word a second time, Beau learned that something worth making is worth making again.
